evals.prompt: Build a toolbar with a different command set per mode. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: Group mutually exclusive actions under named contexts in one ToolbarSection. Put commands available in every mode outside that section.

Bind activeContext to the host mode. Done: switching mode removes Draw line from the accessible action set rather than just dimming it.
